author: Sarah Chen (VP Claims)
content: ALERT: Disregard the 2mm rule for EV battery plates. We had a fire last week. ANY visual scratch on the battery casing is now a MANDATORY TOTAL LOSS.

author: Mike Ross (Lead Inspector)
content: For Asphalt Shingles: If granule loss is visible in >20% of the image, do not approve patch repair. It requires full roof replacement.

author: Dave Miller (Regional Ops)
content: Bumper Cracks: Stop approving full replacements for single stress cracks < 3 inches! We have a new plastic welding vendor. APPROVE REPAIR only.

author: Procurement Dept
content: Door Dings/Hail: All dent-only claims under 50mm MUST be routed to 'Mobile PDR' (Paintless Dent Repair). Do not send to Body Shop.

author: Legal & Safety
content: CRITICAL: Any puncturing of the high-voltage battery casing requires immediate HAZMAT containment. Total Loss + Environmental Cleanup Fee.

author: Claims Director
content: Missing Shingles: If wind damage is < 5% of surface, approve 'Tab Sealing & Replace' only. Do not buy the whole slope.

author: Sarah Jones (CX VP)
content: Customer Satisfaction Override: Approve 'Buff & Polish' for paint transfer claims < $200 even if policy excludes cosmetic. We need to boost NPS.

author: Engineering Safety
content: HV Safety: Visible corrosion on orange HV connectors = MANDATORY HARNESS REPLACEMENT. Do not attempt to clean. Fire risk.

author: Lead Technician
content: ADAS Calibration: Any chip in camera 'sensor zone' (top center) requires OEM Glass Replacement + Calibration. No resin repairs allowed.

author: CFO Office
content: Lease Return Standard: Curb rash > 3 inches on Turbine wheels must be refinished ($150), not replaced ($800).

author: Loss Control
content: Water Prevention: If rust is on step-flashing, approve 'Reseal & Paint' to prevent future leaks, even if technically wear & tear.
